# libc_startup.initial_stack.txt - the initial process stack the native reference run (libc_startup.steptrace.txt) started on.
# A measurement: never hand-edit it. The body below is the verbatim output of
#   nativetrace --custom --stack FILE libc_startup /bin/prog
# and regenerate.sh re-creates it and diffs it against this file.
# What the ENGINE must reproduce so that musl executes the same instructions (each item sets a loop count or a branch in musl's startup):
#   - argc=1 and argv[0]="/bin/prog" (9 bytes: __init_libc scans argv[0] for '/');
#   - exactly 2 env strings, then exactly the 15 auxv entries listed below (the auxv loop runs once per entry; every type is below
#     musl's AUX_CNT of 38, so each value is stored);
#   - AT_PHDR/AT_PHENT/AT_PHNUM describing the ELF program headers as loaded in guest memory (static_init_tls walks them);
#   - AT_UID==AT_EUID, AT_GID==AT_EGID, AT_SECURE==0, else __init_libc takes a poll()+open() fallback (objdump 0x40129a-0x40132a)
#     that this trace never enters;
#   - a non-null AT_RANDOM pointing at 16 readable bytes (here 00 11 22 .. ff).
# Layout: the addresses are those of nativetrace.c's builder (stack top 0x1000000, rsp 16-byte aligned at entry, strings above the
# auxv). The engine should reproduce them exactly so the whole stack can be compared byte for byte; rsp % 16 == 0 is required anyway.
mode=custom
entry_rip=0x401061
rsp_at_entry=0xfffe70 (rsp % 16 = 0)
argc=1
argv[0]=0xffffc6 "/bin/prog"
envp[0]=0xffffd0 "PATH=/usr/bin:/bin"
envp[1]=0xffffe3 "HOME=/root"
envc=2
auxv AT_PHDR          ( 3) = 0x400040
auxv AT_PHENT         ( 4) = 0x38
auxv AT_PHNUM         ( 5) = 0x8
auxv AT_PAGESZ        ( 6) = 0x1000
auxv AT_ENTRY         ( 9) = 0x401061
auxv AT_UID           (11) = 0x3e8
auxv AT_EUID          (12) = 0x3e8
auxv AT_GID           (13) = 0x3e8
auxv AT_EGID          (14) = 0x3e8
auxv AT_SECURE        (23) = 0x0
auxv AT_RANDOM        (25) = 0xffffa0
auxv AT_HWCAP         (16) = 0x0
auxv AT_CLKTCK        (17) = 0x64
auxv AT_PLATFORM      (15) = 0xffffbf
auxv AT_EXECFN        (31) = 0xffffee
auxv AT_NULL          ( 0) = 0x0
auxv_end=0xffffa0
